source: site/dial-practical/common/abadis-common.js — F.surgery. The file comment says these are the formulas on the live abadis-med.com calculator: water = n * 1.6 * 9.3, cost = n * 2.5 * 85000, hours = n * 1.7 / 60 * 2.2 * 7.1. Factors below are copied unchanged. Do not replace them with rounded marketing figures.

chemicals.why: dial-practical has no separate chemical quantity. Wash and disinfectant cost is already inside costToman (calculator label: هزینه شست‌وشو و ضدعفونی). Do not show a bottle count or a chemical volume.

display.note: The calculator displays Math.round of each running total. This game keeps the exact products and rounds only when drawing the total, the same way.

gameRules.note: Everything in gameRules is pacing for the toy, not a hospital statistic. Savings per completed swap still come only from formula.
